meta.title: Walter Nights — Fullstack Engineer
meta.description: Fullstack Engineer building AI-powered SaaS platforms. A portfolio of personal and enterprise projects.

hero.subtitle: I design and build SaaS systems end-to-end — from the data model to the interface — with a focus on applied AI, integrations, and shipping speed.

about.title: An engineer who thinks about the business before the code.
paragraphs: I work as a Fullstack Engineer at Geeks5G, where I lead and build SaaS platforms that mix automation, AI, and real daily operations — from digital marketing to bookkeeping and education.

I like the intersection where product meets engineering: understanding why the business needs a feature before deciding how to implement it. When something can be simplified into three lines, I prefer that over inventing an abstraction for six hypothetical cases.
Outside of work I keep personal projects that force me to try new stacks — that's how I show up to a repo with judgment, not just curiosity.

items.description: Build and maintain the agency's internal platforms — RankTitan, OptimAds, Google Services API — covering backend, frontend, infra, and product decisions. Integrate Google APIs (Ads, GMB, Analytics), automate local SEO processes, and work with LLMs for content generation and analysis.

projects.title: Things I've built
projects.note: A mix of personal projects and enterprise work. Some are closed under NDA — I show screenshots and description, no public code.

items.name: RankTitan
items.description: SEO ranking platform for Google My Business, Google Ads, and Local SEO. Automates GMB profile audits, manages campaigns, and generates keyword ranking reports.

items.name: Tax Bookkeeping
items.description: Payment and bank account management system for SMBs. Reconciles transactions, generates chart of accounts, and produces accountant-ready tax reports.

items.name: Google Services API
items.description: Central API orchestrating automation across Google Ads, GMB, Local SEO, and Analytics. The foundation RankTitan and OptimAds run on.

items.name: SkilTak
items.description: Personal platform to centralize the job hunt: aggregates offers from multiple portals, matches them against the profile via AI, and generates tailored CVs and cover letters.

items.name: OptimAds
items.description: Ad campaign monitoring system and CRM for local SEO analysis. Detects spend anomalies and suggests strategy adjustments with AI.

items.name: Estudiant
items.description: Academic management platform and virtual campus for educational institutions. Covers enrollment, course catalog, calendar, evaluations, and teacher-student communication.

items.name: Archtomatic
items.description: Platform for architects: inventory, quotes, budgets, and generation of renders and blueprints from natural-language descriptions.

contact.title: Want to work together?
